source_note: Both native binaries contain the same preexisting local SVG changes, excluded from these commits. The baseline is the published round-seven candidate; its XCTest binary and unchanged fixed-work source match the previous recorded hashes. Only the renderer package, portable CMake targets and standalone lab were built. No full Telegram build.

fixed_work_comparison.method: Two prebuilt renderer XCTest bundles, 120 tracks and 60 completed mutation states per mode. Separate serial processes use identical optimization settings. One state in flight; document and scroll tile completion checked. Applied state and installed-tree pixel checks run outside measured intervals. Process CPU includes worker threads. Elapsed time includes completion barriers. Work equality requires identical completed state, layout, document job, document install, scroll raster, tile job and compositor raster counts across all rounds of each mode. Renderer callbacks are not treated as completed frames. This is a renderer-component comparison, not WebKit, full-host throughput or display FPS. The checkout workload source and both bundle executable hashes must remain unchanged throughout the comparison; callers must build both bundles from the same workload source.
fixed_work_comparison.order: Before then after in round 1; reversed in alternate rounds

comparison.method: Serial baseline and optimized native binaries plus WebKit; reverse order in round two. Both native binaries enable the published scroll batching and obsolete-raster cancellation. Both retain canonical resolved paint exclusion caching. Selected uses guarded shallow restyling for width-only edits while retaining normal layout and independent descendant text/transform patches. Experimental scroll-owned takeover is disabled. Transport recording disabled. CPU is percent of one core, including WebKit helpers, excluding WindowServer. Host callbacks are not display FPS.

new_fixture.integration: Shared resource files for All Widgets and All Widgets — WebKit. Applies on the next app build; the installed Telegram app was not rebuilt or changed.

remaining_limits: No universal speed advantage or twofold improvement over WebKit is established.
Live callback counts do not measure displayed FPS or equal completed painting.
CPU comparisons include WebKit helpers and exclude shared WindowServer work; they are not total-system energy measurements.
Benchmarks use sandbox-backed WebKit with the same QuickJS workload, not raw HTML/JavaScriptCore browser performance.
The width optimization is portable C++; runtime performance and UI validation here are on macOS arm64 only.
Layout and rasterization remain necessary; heavy clipping, gradients and continuous resizing remain bottlenecks.

import json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageStat
root=Path('/private/tmp/widget-stress-round8')
repo=Path('/Users/renoir/projects/Telegram/telegrammacos')
folder=root/'frozen-selected';folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
rows=[]
for fixture in sorted((repo/'tools/perflab/widget-stress').glob('*.html')):
 html=folder/fixture.name
 html.write_text(fixture.read_text()+'<script>setTimeout(function(){window.stress.freeze();},1000);</script>')
 images={}
 for variant in ['before','after']+(['webkit'] if fixture.stem in ['gradient-clips'] else []):
  lab=root/('TwidgetLab-before' if variant=='before' else 'TwidgetLab-final')
  out=folder/(fixture.stem+'-'+variant)
  result=subprocess.run([str(lab),'capture',str(html),'--renderer','web' if variant=='webkit' else 'lite','--out',str(out),'--width','480','--max-height','6000','--theme','dark','--seconds','3.5','--logs','--visible','--screenshot'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
  log=result.stdout+result.stderr
  (folder/(fixture.stem+'-'+variant+'.log')).write_text(log)
  assert result.returncode==0 and 'rendered=true dead=- error=-' in log,(fixture.name,variant,log[-1000:])
  images[variant]=Image.open(out/(fixture.stem+('.png' if variant=='webkit' else '.lite.png'))).convert('RGBA')
 a,b=images['before'],images['after']
 assert a.size==b.size,(fixture.name,a.size,b.size)
 delta=ImageChops.difference(a,b)
 row=dict(fixture=fixture.stem,size=a.size,changed_bytes=sum(v for i,v in enumerate(delta.histogram()) if i%256),max_channel_delta=max(h[1] for h in delta.getextrema()),mean_rgba=sum(ImageStat.Stat(delta).mean)/4)
 if 'webkit' in images:
  web=images['webkit'];row['webkit_size']=web.size
  if web.size==b.size:row['webkit_mean_rgb']=sum(ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(b.convert('RGB'),web.convert('RGB'))).mean)/3
 a=Image.open(folder/(fixture.stem+'-before')/(fixture.stem+'.lite.screen.png')).convert('RGBA')
 b=Image.open(folder/(fixture.stem+'-after')/(fixture.stem+'.lite.screen.png')).convert('RGBA')
 assert a.size==b.size
 d=ImageChops.difference(a,b)
 row['window_size']=a.size
 row['window_changed_bytes']=sum(v for i,v in enumerate(d.histogram()) if i%256)
 row['window_max_channel_delta']=max(h[1] for h in d.getextrema())
 rows.append(row);print(row,flush=True)
 (folder/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
